id.description: Unique identifier for the logical object that instance of this type represents.

name.description: The name of the component. Optional field for informational purposes only.

dataSpec.description:
The data settings for this component.

@uiSdlDesignerCustomRenderer(rendererType='')

disableDataRequestOnFirstRender.description: Disable if you want to avoid sending any and all requests for this component on first render.

triggersRegistered.description: Whether the effect triggers and epics have been registered

wrapWithMetadataId.description: Whether to wrap the component with a div which has a class name of its metdata id. Useful for targeting with css.

settings.description: Settings set by users from the Bulk Model Config UI.

numCompletedJobs.description: Stores a count of the number of previously completed model configuration runs.

hyperparameterData.description: Contains the hyperparameter data for the selected bulk model template.

inlineNotificationConfig.description: Contains information to be shown in Inline notification inside Bulk Model Config Modal.

currentlyOpenModelConfigRun.description: Currently open ModelConfigRun in Model Configuration Jobs grid in Mondel Management

selectedAssetIdsWithoutDataset.description:
The list of {@link ReliabilityAsset} IDs selected by the user that does not have a {@link ReliabilityMlDatasetPreparationRun}.
This information is used to display the "Assets With No Dataset" grid in the Bulk Model Config Check Modal.

selectedAssetIdsWithDataset.description:
The list of {@link ReliabilityAsset} IDs selected by the user that have a {@link ReliabilityMlDatasetPreparationRun}.
This information is used to display the "Assets With Dataset" grid in the Bulk Model Config Check Modal.

templateData.description: The list of model templates that can be chosen.

selectedModels.description:
List of selected models for bulk model configuration.

This field is used to filter the fetched models on "Selected Models" grid under the Bulk Model Config Modal.

selectedCVs.description:
List of selected [CVs](ReliabilityAsset) for bulk model configuration.

This field is used to filter the fetched models on "Selected CVs" grid under the Bulk Model Config Modal.

loadingModelConfig.description: When true, the model configuration UI is in the loading state.

usingBulkDataPrep.description: When `true`, bulk model configuration is initiated from bulk data preparation.

isSensorAssociationFlow.description: When `true`, bulk model configuration is initiated from sensor association workflow.

usingBulkSensorAssociation.description:
When `true`, bulk model configuration is initiated from bulk sensor association workflow.
This means that we need to perform both sensor association and model configuration when starting the job.

sensorAssociationFlowTargetAssetIds.description:
When `isSensorAssociationFlow` is `true`, this field contains the ids of the assets selected for model config
based on the selected assets from the grid, or the assets selected from the sensor association flow.

sensorAssociationFlowErrorAssets.description:
When `isSensorAssociationFlow` is `true`, this field contains the ids of the assets that are not ready for
model configuration.

title: Application state that stores all the UI logic for Bulk Model Configuration.
name: BulkModelConfigApplicationState
